entries.acceptance: Author selects predetermined attitude or a three-dice reaction procedure. Do not roll for a predetermined vital encounter; keep private attitude separate from player-visible dialogue. A reaction guides permitted authored behavior rather than controlling player decisions.
entries.implementation_note: Owned private roll/predetermined machinery authored; execution checks paused.

entries.acceptance: Dispatch general attitude, possible combat, trade, aid, information and loyalty separately. Professional information sales use trade; interrogation uses its skill procedure. Existing combat does not become friendship from a favorable morale result.
entries.implementation_note: Potential combat/morale decision assessment authored. Other context dispatch and world consequence execution remain pending; checks unrun.

entries.acceptance: Information outcomes cannot reveal facts beyond the respondent’s knowledge. Track truth as believed, actual truth, deliberate lies and incomplete answers separately. An uncertain knowledge check uses intelligence or the relevant skill.
entries.implementation_note: Owned belief/fabrication delivery and once-per-statement uncertain knowledge checks authored. Research execution and complete validation remain pending; checks unrun.

entries.acceptance: Persist hidden loyalty separately from competence. Hiring and taking employment can both establish it. Integrate later loyalty changes and authorized insight without leaking hidden state in preview.
entries.implementation_note: Private initial rating and persistent incident checks authored. Later changes and behavioral consequences remain pending; checks unrun.

entries.acceptance: Use the local current fair price, not a universal catalogue price. Without bargaining, roll only when willingness to transact remains uncertain.
entries.implementation_note: Unambiguous pricing authored; altered offers at bands 1–5 explicitly blocked by source discrepancy. Trade execution and validation remain pending.

entries.acceptance: Use a revised offered price as counteroffer basis only when less favorable to the player than the fair-price basis. B562 prints an example equating half of 120% with 50%; visually confirmed inconsistency. Define and test a resolution policy before executable completion.
entries.implementation_note: Unambiguous pricing authored; altered offers at bands 1–5 explicitly blocked by source discrepancy. Trade execution and validation remain pending.

entries.acceptance: Ordinary bargaining cannot reduce purchase price below half fair value. An ulterior motive requires an explicit authored exception and consequence, not an unrestricted discount.
entries.implementation_note: Unambiguous pricing authored; altered offers at bands 1–5 explicitly blocked by source discrepancy. Trade execution and validation remain pending.

entries.acceptance: Successful context-appropriate skill can add +2; identify the contributing check and avoid duplicate application.
entries.validation_note: Owned Administration and Carousing checks validate concrete reaction context, apply action permission and authored duration, then retain the recorded modifier in the private encounter. Success gives +2; Carousing failure gives persistent -2, Administration failure gives no bonus. Retry/replay cannot replace the check or duplicate time and randomness. Predetermined reactions bypass it. Expected values, changed-approach persistence, rollback, undo and saved continuation assertions authored, unrun. Other appropriate skills, entertainment purchasing, special Carousing dangers and carry-over across separately authored encounters remain pending. Carousing entertainment now has an owned author-priced purchase transferring existing payer/provider balances once and adding +1 to +3 to the skill check, with affordability and availability preflight. Failure retains the charge; replay retains the receipt. Money conservation, modifier effects, rollback, undo and saved continuation assertions authored, unrun. Drink consumption and intoxication remain pending. Preparation now revalidates encounter state and bound definitions after elapsed time before payment/rolling and before storing its result. Injected audience, price, payment-capacity, definition-length and intervening-reaction rollback/retry assertions authored, unrun.

entries.acceptance: Specified social skills at level 20+ supply an automatic +2 where eligible; resolve exact skill definitions.
entries.validation_note: One selected Diplomacy or Fast-Talk mastery source now supplies its automatic +2 at skill 20+, with Fast-Talk requiring authored permission to speak. The owned reaction attempt records the contribution once without a skill roll, retains the total on replay, and bypasses mastery for predetermined reactions. Threshold, speaking, replay, rollback, undo and saved continuation assertions authored, unrun. Combining multiple mastery sources, other eligible catalogue skills and the separate successful-skill-check bonus remain pending.
